description.narrative:
Denmark’s overarching vision for engagement in Ethiopia from 2025 to 2029 is to enhance the country's resilience, foster green growth, and promote stability. Denmark will pursue this vision through three complementary strategic objectives. Promoting human rights serves both as a goal and a foundation for engagement across these strategic objectives, supporting the overall vision. I. Strengthen resilience and future opportunities. Denmark will strengthen the resilience of vulnerable populations by focusing on food security, livelihoods and employment to fight poverty and inequality.
II. Support conflict-sensitive and inclusive green growth. Denmark will contribute to green growth through multiple instruments supporting Ethiopia’s green ambitions in agriculture, forestry, water, and energy.
III. Promote human rights, social cohesion, peace and stability. Denmark will promote human rights and social cohesion through critical dialogue and support to national and local governmental and civil society actors. This will further contribute to peace and stability, supported through Denmark’s regional approach in the Horn of Africa.
